share.message: Download Tibus — book bus tickets easily!
landing.hero_title: Book Your Bus Ticket in Seconds
landing.hero_desc: Search routes, compare prices, and book seats instantly. Travel across West Africa with confidence.
landing.travelers_desc: Everything you need to plan and book your bus journey in one app.
landing.feature_search_desc: Find bus trips by route, date, and price. Book your seat in seconds.
landing.feature_mobile_desc: Get your ticket on your phone. Show the QR code to board.
landing.feature_secure_desc: Pay safely with mobile money. Your transaction is protected.
landing.feature_track_desc: See available seats, departure times, and trip details live.
landing.companies_desc: Manage your fleet, sell tickets, and track performance — all from one dashboard.
landing.company_sell_desc: Reach more customers. Sell tickets 24/7 without extra staff.
landing.company_manage_desc: Add station agents, track their sales, and manage commissions.
landing.company_analytics_desc: See revenue, bookings, and occupancy rates in real-time dashboards.
landing.company_fleet_desc: Manage buses, stations, routes, and trip schedules all in one place.
landing.testimonials_desc: Trusted by thousands of travelers and bus companies across West Africa.
landing.testimonial1_text: I used to spend hours at the station waiting for a bus. Now I book online and just show up. Tibus saved me so much time!
landing.testimonial2_text: Since joining Tibus, our ticket sales increased by 40%. The analytics dashboard helps us optimize our routes.
landing.testimonial3_text: The mobile ticket is so convenient. No more paper tickets to lose. I just scan my QR code and board.
landing.how_desc: Three simple steps to your next trip
landing.step1_desc: Enter your origin, destination, and travel date.
landing.step2_desc: Compare companies, prices, and departure times.
landing.step3_desc: Pay securely and receive your digital ticket instantly.
landing.cta_desc: Join thousands of travelers who book their bus tickets with Tibus every day.

notifications.push_iframe: Publish the app to test push notifications
notifications.optin_description: Get notified about trip departures, booking updates, and important alerts.
guide.page_desc: Learn how to use Tibus as a traveler or as a bus company.
guide.traveler_subtitle: Book your bus ticket in a few simple steps
guide.traveler_step1_desc: Enter your departure city, destination, and travel date to find available trips.
guide.traveler_step2_desc: Compare prices, companies, and departure times. Select your seat and confirm your booking.
guide.traveler_step3_desc: Receive your digital ticket with a QR code. Show it at the station to board the bus.
guide.traveler_step4_desc: Enjoy your trip! After traveling, leave a review to help other travelers choose the best company.
guide.company_subtitle: Manage your bus company and grow your business
guide.company_step1_desc: Create your account and register your bus company. Add your company name, logo, and contact details.
guide.company_step2_desc: Add your buses with their seat capacity. Create stations and define routes between cities.
guide.company_step3_desc: Schedule trips by assigning a bus to a route with departure date, time, and price.
guide.company_step4_desc: Invite station agents to sell tickets on your behalf. Track their sales and manage commissions.
guide.company_step5_desc: Monitor revenue, bookings, and occupancy rates in real-time from your analytics dashboard.
guide.company_step6_desc: Create promo codes, collect traveler reviews, and grow your customer base.
